rules.name: CVE-2026-53362 — Kernel Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-53362: Linux Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that can allow for privilege escalation via IPv6 networking subsystem. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to Suse, Red Hat, and other products using Linux. . Product: Kernel
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where (Message contains "CVE-2026-53362" or Message contains "KERNEL") | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3

rules.name: CVE-2026-86060 — RouterOS Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-86060: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacked to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.. Product: RouterOS
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where (Message contains "CVE-2026-86060" or Message contains "ROUTEROS") | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3

rules.name: CVE-2026-86060 — RouterOS Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-86060: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacked to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.. Product: RouterOS
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID in (4672, 4688) and (CommandLine contains "sudo" or CommandLine contains "runas") | summarize count() by Account, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

rules.name: CVE-2026-42016 — Artifactory Exploitation
